ingredients.title: Seaweed garlic sauce
items: 1/2 cup rapeseed oil (or any neutral oil)

ingredients.title: To serve
items: 2 portions noodles of choice (cooked until still chewy), reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid
Chives or spring onion to garnish

steps: In a small saucepan with the garlic, shallots and oil, cook on medium-high heat until browned (about 5 min). Allow to cool a little.
Toast your seaweed for a few seconds in a pan, over the stove, or gently with a blowtorch.
Food process or stick blend everything with the seasoning. Taste and adjust if needed.
Cook your noodles until they still have a chew and reserve some of the cooking liquid.
In a large pan on high heat, add the sauce and noodles and stir fry with the reserved liquid for a couple of minutes.
Serve, garnished with chives or spring onion.
